name: InterContinental Perth City Centre
positioning: City-centre InterContinental in Perth with Club InterContinental high above the city and venues on historic Hay Street
best_for: Travelers who want Club InterContinental access with panoramic Perth City views
Food lovers keen on a hands-on, chef-led grill masterclass

facts.text: Club InterContinental is a private sanctuary high above the city with panoramic views of Perth City.
Club InterContinental offers a la carte breakfast, all-day refreshments, afternoon tea and evening canapes.
The Loft Lounge & Bar's terrace is set against the backdrop of His Majesty's Theatre and historic Hay Street.
The Loft Lounge & Bar has an outdoor terrace amid Perth's heritage facades, serving classic cocktails and Western Australian wines.
The Loft Lounge & Bar has live music every Friday.
Ascua offers chef-led tomahawk and seafood masterclasses at its wood-fire grill.
Each masterclass includes recipes and a trio of Ascua's signature sea salts to take home.
Ascua has a theatre-style open kitchen with a wood-fired grill, cooking Western Australian produce.
Heno & Rey serves Spanish tapas with alfresco dining on the corner of King and Hay Street.
The hotel has two restaurants and one bar.

considerations.text: Ascua masterclasses need a minimum of two guests and advance booking.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style amenities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
